summary_en: Annual dividend raised ¥94 → ¥110 per share (+¥16) for FY3/27. Interim dividend revised to ¥55/share (previously ¥47); year-end dividend revised to ¥55/share (previously ¥47). Nikkei 225 sustained above ¥60,000 and underlying business earnings growth since May dividend forecast triggered expansion while preserving growth investment capacity and financial soundness.
title_en: Notice of Revision to Interim and Year-End Dividend Forecasts for FY3/27 (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief: On 31 July 2026, SPARX Group announced a revision to its FY3/27 dividend forecast via board resolution. The company raised its full-year dividend guidance from ¥94 per share to ¥110 per share, an increase of ¥16. Specifically, the interim dividend (Q2) was revised upward from ¥47 to ¥55 per share, and the year-end dividend was similarly revised from ¥47 to ¥55 per share. The revision reflects sustained strength in the Nikkei 225 (trading above ¥60,000) and continuous growth in the company's underlying business earnings (measured by its proprietary "fundamental earnings" metric) since the prior dividend guidance issued on 7 May 2026. Management stated that after careful review of capital allocation—including future growth investment plans, adequate cash reserves, and shareholder returns—it determined that enhanced shareholder returns were appropriate while preserving financial soundness and growth capacity. The year-end dividend remains subject to formal approval by the ordinary general meeting of shareholders scheduled for June 2027.
